handback.title: Wiki install page uses the thin workflow
handback.summary: The wiki's install page tells adopters to add one workflow and one settings file, never a copy of Dokima.
handback.user_story: Adopters following the wiki install page add only the thin workflow and settings file, never Dokima's code.

acceptance_criteria.text: When an adopter reads the wiki install page, no line tells them to add Dokima's workflows or code folder.
acceptance_criteria.words: The 815.1 test must fail on any line telling adopters to put Dokima's `.github/workflows/` or `dokima/` folders in their repo, whatever the verb.

edge_cases.case: The step uses another verb than copy, like put or add.

acceptance_criteria.text: When an adopter reads the wiki install page, it tells them to add the one thin workflow file.
acceptance_criteria.words: the page tells adopters to add the one workflow and the settings file
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One fixed page with no input; the test reads every line.

acceptance_criteria.text: When an adopter reads the wiki install page, it tells them to add the settings file.
acceptance_criteria.words: the page tells adopters to add the one workflow and the settings file
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One fixed page with no input; the test reads every line.

acceptance_criteria.text: When an adopter reads the wiki install page, it says the workflow and settings file are the whole install.
acceptance_criteria.words: The page names those two files as the whole install.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One fixed page with no input; the test reads every line.

acceptance_criteria.text: When an adopter reads the wiki install page, it lists none of Dokima's own workflows as files to add.
acceptance_criteria.words: It stops listing Dokima's own workflows, including `playthrough.yml` and `wiki.yml`, as things to add.

edge_cases.case: The play-through and wiki workflows the owner named are not listed.

acceptance_criteria.text: When an adopter reads the wiki install page, it never lists the code owners file among the files to add.
acceptance_criteria.words: The page may mention it once as optional, for naming approvers other than the owner, but never among the files to add.

edge_cases.case: The page mentions the file once, saying it is optional.
